evidence: The reporter describes missing animation, an overly dark shadow over the taskbar, and a second click that closes and reopens the panel.
The only reproduction step currently states to left-click the tray icon once while another window is focused.
No PowerToys version, Windows version/build, display configuration, scaling, or bug report is provided.

comment.body: Please provide the exact PowerToys version and Windows version/build, the number of connected monitors and display-scaling percentages, and the precise click sequence that reproduces each symptom. In particular, please state whether the first click is made while another window is focused, whether the Quick Access panel is already open, and whether the second click is on the tray icon or the panel. A short screen recording showing the shadow over the taskbar and the close-and-reopen behavior, together with a fresh PowerToys bug report generated immediately after reproducing it, would help us investigate this reliably.
